messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: performance testing for 2.0
parts:
I don't think we want to release a new version that's
slower than the old version in average n_eff/sec terms
or one that has much variance run to run in n_eff/sec.

So we need some tests. How about 20 runs or so for all
of the models in our test suite, 4 chains each, with
four measurements per model:

mean minimum r_hat
mean average r_hat
mean n_eff/sec

If we scatterplot that out in three plots and they look OK,
I'd be happy releasing a new way of doing sampling and
adaptation.

Of course, we need to resolve the Mac vs. Windows bug,
too. Daniel and I are going to sit down and try to closely
code review the adaptation, which is where things seem
to be going wrong in the sense that we're getting different
answers on Windows vs. Mac and the Windows answers look
better.

- Bob
